entities.name: Table T1 – Credit Markets – Fixed Rate Inflows and Outflows
entities.brief: Quarterly inflows, outflows, and net flows for fixed rate products from 3Q16 to 3Q24
entities.description: Highlights significant inflow surge and net flow dynamics, including a drop in 1Q22 and peak in 3Q23

properties.key_insight: Following a negative net flow of -$4bn in 1Q22, net flows surged to a peak of $30bn in 3Q23.

entities.name: Table T2 – Credit Markets – ABF now accounts for ~3% of insurance investments
entities.brief: Allocation of insurers' investments across asset classes
entities.description: Highlights ABF's current 3% share, suggesting significant room for growth

properties.table_content:
| Investment Category         | Percentage of Total Investments |
|-----------------------------|---------------------------------|
| Commercial Real Estate Lending | 13%                             |
| Private Placements          | 11%                             |
| Residential Mortgages       | 4%                              |
| Asset-based finance         | 3%                              |
| Mid-Market Lending          | 2%                              |
| Infrastructure Fund Finance | 1%                              |
| Other                       | 0%                              |
properties.key_insight: Asset-based finance currently represents 3% of insurers' total investments, indicating significant room for growth.
